global_discoveries.technical_takeaway: OpenAI's new Agents API commoditizes memory/reasoning orchestration; 20 GitHub repos detailed for agent memory (Mem0, Graphiti, Cognee, Letta), tools (Composio, Browser Use), execution (E2B, OpenHands), observability (AgentOps, Langfuse); example stacks for coding/research/persistent/production agents.

Persistent memory across agents enables coordinated team-like workflows with shared context, permissions, and progress; key unlock for long-running agent loops beyond isolated sessions.
